unknown.title: We couldn't find this academy
unknown.body: Check the address for typing mistakes. If an academy sent you this link, ask them for the correct one.

suspended.title: {academy} is temporarily unavailable
suspended.body: This academy's workspace is paused for now. Nothing has been deleted. If you run this academy, contact AcademyBee support to restore access.

archived.title: This academy is no longer on AcademyBee
archived.body: The workspace at this address has been closed. If you need your records, contact the academy directly.

setup.title: {academy} is getting ready
setup.body: This academy is still setting up its workspace on AcademyBee. Please check back soon.

accessDenied.title: You don't have access to this page
accessDenied.body: Your account can't open this part of {academy}. If you think this is a mistake, ask your academy's administrator.

unavailable.title: We can't reach AcademyBee right now
unavailable.body: This is usually temporary. Wait a moment and try again — nothing you saved has been lost.

home.title: Welcome to {academy}
home.body: This is {academy}'s workspace on AcademyBee. Staff sign-in arrives in the next release.

preparing.title: {academy} on AcademyBee
preparing.body: This academy's workspace is being prepared. Please check back soon.

hub.title: AcademyBee Family Hub
hub.body: One app for parents and students across every academy they belong to. Your academy will invite you when it's ready.
